description: What delegating earns on a mainnet, as BitBasic's rewards calculator works it out: the yearly rate for any validator or a chosen one (after its commission), and for an amount, what it earns per day, month, year or a number of days. An estimate from today's rates, without restaking, not a promise or advice.

amount.description: Whole tokens to delegate, such as "1000" or "2500.5". Default: rates only.

days.description: A period in days to estimate for, besides day, month and year.

fee.description: Mina only: the pool's fee in percent, which Mina pools keep off-chain.

network.description: A network slug from list-networks (mainnets only).

validator.description: A validator address on that network. Default: the network's rate.

name: estimate-staking-rewards
title: Estimate staking rewards
